item.title: Your guests are the ad.
item.description:
The best activations do not fight the phone in your guest's hand. They give it something worth capturing.
Plan the print, the clip or the photo first. The booth is just how you deliver it.
Four questions to answer before your next event: link in bio.

item.title: Screens are winning the street.
item.description:
Digital billboards are projected to grow 14.5% in the US this year. Traditional billboards: 1.5%.
The difference is flexibility. No print costs, messages that change by the day, and strong locations shared between brands. That is the model behind our screen on Hope Road.
Full story at the link in our bio. Source: Guideline, via PPC Land.
#TheBiggerPicture #DOOH #DigitalBillboard #Kingston #JamaicaMarketing

item.title: Creators are not the experiment anymore. They are the budget.
item.description:
US brands are forecast to spend $21.1B on creator marketing in 2026, more than double 2022.
The bigger shift: creator content now runs well beyond the feed, in paid ads, on screens and in-store. If you plan to reuse it, agree the usage rights in the brief.
Full story at the link in our bio. Source: EMARKETER, via Net Influencer.
#TheBiggerPicture #CreatorEconomy #InfluencerMarketing #Jamaica
